paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on Llama3.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for various models. The x-axis represents Co-occurrence Number on a logarithmic scale, with values ranging from approximately 1 to 10^3. The y-axis represents ACC (%) on a linear scale, with values ranging from 60 to 80. The plot features six lines, each representing a different model: Base (black, solid, circle markers), FT (blue, solid, triangle markers), IKE (red, solid, triangle markers), MEND (brown, solid, diamond markers), MEMIT (purple, solid), and ROME (green, solid, square markers). The Base line starts at around 61% and increases to approximately 66% as Co-occurrence Number increases from 1 to 10^3. The FT line starts at around 63% and increases to approximately 69% over the same range. The IKE line starts at around 65% and increases to approximately 70%. The MEND line starts at around 66% and increases to approximately 74%. The MEMIT line starts at around 67% and increases to approximately 72%. The ROME line starts at around 74% and increases to approximately 77%.
